tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Assistable's registered MCP tools by the task the user wants to do. Returns up to 5 exact tool definitions with JSON input schemas and annotations. Use this first when you need to choose a tool; the result is not authorization to call it.

tools.name: assistants_list
tools.description: List assistants in a subaccount (excludes archived by default). Note: voice_settings and platform_tools are returned only by assistants_get, not in the list.

tools.name: assistants_get
tools.description: Fetch an assistant's full configuration by ID. The response includes voice_settings (greeting mode, opening messages, voicemail) and platform_tools (attached platform-catalog tool names).

tools.name: assistants_create
tools.description: Create an assistant. Required: subAccountId, name. Optional config blocks (llmConfig, voiceConfig, chatConfig) mirror the dashboard create dialog. voice_settings configures call greeting mode, opening messages, and voicemail behavior; platform_tools attaches platform-catalog tools (declarative full-

tools.name: assistants_update
tools.description: Patch an assistant. Only supplied fields change; nested config blocks are upserted. voice_settings updates call greeting mode, opening messages, and voicemail behavior; platform_tools declaratively replaces the attached platform-catalog tools (an empty array detaches all — see the field description)

tools.name: assistants_archive
tools.description: Archive (soft-delete) an assistant.

tools.name: tools_list
tools.description: List tools visible to a subaccount. Pass includePrebuilt=false for only custom tools.

tools.name: tools_get
tools.description: Fetch a tool's full configuration.

tools.name: tools_create_custom
tools.description: Create a custom tool (toolType=CUSTOM). Name must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/ and be unique in the subaccount.

tools.name: tools_update
tools.description: Patch a custom tool. Supplying parameters/headers replaces those rows; omit to leave them.

tools.name: tools_delete
tools.description: Soft-delete a custom tool.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: List contacts in a subaccount. meta.total is the number of matching contacts, so use it to answer how many contacts there are.

tools.name: contacts_get
tools.description: Fetch a contact by ID.

tools.name: conversations_list
tools.description: List conversations in a subaccount.

tools.name: appointments_list
tools.description: List appointments in a subaccount within an optional date range.

tools.name: calls_get
tools.description: Fetch a call (status, recording, transcript) by ID.

tools.name: assistable_connect_finish
tools.description: Check an assistable_connect sign-in. error.code authorization_pending means the person has not approved yet: wait interval seconds and call again. On approval it returns api_key once: use it as the Authorization: Bearer header for this MCP server (mcp_url) and keep it safe; it cannot be shown again.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "assistable_signup_finish" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assistants_get, calls_get · Private data: contacts_list, contacts_get, assistable_connect, assistable_signup_finish · Public sink: assistable_connect, assistable_signup, assistable_signup_finish · Destructive: assistants_archive, tools_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assistants_get, calls_get · Private data: contacts_list, contacts_get, assistable_connect, assistable_signup_finish · Public sink: assistable_connect, assistable_signup, assistable_signup_finish · Destructive: assistants_archive, tools_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
